Wikipedia (en), X Corps (United States), read 27 October 2026: the corps was activated on 15 May 1942 at Sherman, Texas, and in the Second World War served only in the Southwest Pacific (New Guinea, Leyte, Mindanao; Sixth and Eighth Army); the page does not place it in Europe. The table entry is therefore not confirmed by any source read and may be a misprint of another corps; this record keeps the identity only and the theater is `pacific`, the one the sources read give; whether an X Corps headquarters stood in the European Theater in April 1945 is open. Review (27 October 2026): formed_date old blank, new 1942-05-15 (the activation date given in the text of the page; the infobox gives 1 May 1942 as the start of the active span and that value is not used); reason: the column holds formation or activation (schema/README.md, docs/methodology.md), and the text of the page states the activation date and place.
